result.headline: Roll and yaw tracked poorly, with roll lagging its setpoint about 1 s; cause not separable from this recording
result.explanation: The roll setpoint swings about ±43 deg and the aircraft follows about 1 s late, while outputs move in step with the setpoint. A low-voltage warning at start-up leaves a power or response-lag cause open.

checked.check: Roll setpoint vs roll response, 19.97-33.283 s
checked.result: Correlation is 0.793 at zero lag and 0.968 at a lag of 0.983 s. Typical difference is 15.985 deg.
checked.about: Control-loop response lag rather than a dead actuator

checked.check: Which signals leave baseline first, 18-34 s
checked.result: velocity[x] leaves first at 19.536 s, then ch4/ch5 at 21.19 s, ch3 at 21.893 s, yaw at 23.647 s. Roll is not listed as leaving baseline; its setpoint is already swinging.

checked.check: Actuator outputs vs roll during 19-34 s
checked.result: ch3, ch4 and ch5 swing about ±100 us in step with the roll setpoint. ch0 and ch6 stay at 1500 us and ch7 at 1926 us. The outputs respond to the controller.
Typical |error| is up to 163 deg. Yaw is unwrapped to -431 deg while the setpoint stays within -126..169, so this is likely a wrap or representation artifact.
